import Mathlib

open Set Nat Function

/--
Let $k$ be a positive integer. Prove that there exist polynomials $P_0(n), P_1(n), \dots, P_{k-1}(n)$ (which may depend on $k$) such that for any integer $n$,
\[
\left\lfloor \frac{n}{k} \right\rfloor^k = P_0(n) + P_1(n) \left\lfloor
\frac{n}{k} \right\rfloor + \cdots + P_{k-1}(n) \left\lfloor \frac{n}{k}
\right\rfloor^{k-1}.
\]
($\lfloor a \rfloor$ means the largest integer $\leq a$.)
-/
theorem putnam_2007_b5
(k : ℕ) (kpos : k > 0) :
(∃ P : Finset.range k → Polynomial ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ, ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ k = ∑ i : Finset.range k, (P i).eval (n : ℝ) * ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ (i : ℕ)) :=
sorry

import Mathlib

open Set Nat Function

theorem putnam_2007_b5
(k : ℕ) (kpos : k > 0) :
(∃ P : Finset.range k → Polynomial ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ, ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ k = ∑ i : Finset.range k, (P i).eval (n : ℝ) * ⌊(n : ℝ) / k⌋ ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℕ → Polynomial (Polynomial ℝ), g = fun j =>
      Polynomial.C (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℝ) - Polynomial.C (k : Polynomial ℝ) * Polynomial.X
        - Polynomial.C (j : Polynomial ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : Polynomial (Polynomial ℝ), F = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, g j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg1 : ∀ j, (g j).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    intro j; rw [hg]; dsimp only; compute_degree!
  have hg2 : ∀ j, (g j).coeff 1 = -(k : Polynomial ℝ) := by
    intro j; rw [hg]; simp [Polynomial.coeff_C, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  have key : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∏ j ∈ s, g j).natDegree ≤ s.card ∧
      (∏ j ∈ s, g j).coeff s.card = (-(k : Polynomial ℝ)) ^ s.card := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem ha]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
      constructor
      · calc _ ≤ (g a).natDegree + (∏ j ∈ s, g j).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
          _ ≤ 1 + s.card := add_le_add (hg1 a) h1
          _ = _ := by ring
      · rw [show s.card + 1 = 1 + s.card by ring,
          Polynomial.coeff_mul_of_natDegree_le (hg1 a) h1, h2, hg2, pow_succ]
        ring
  have hFdeg : F.natDegree ≤ k ∧ F.coeff k = (-(k : Polynomial ℝ)) ^ k := by
    have := key (Finset.range k)
    rw [Finset.card_range] at this
    rw [hF]; exact this
  have hev : ∀ a b : ℝ, (F.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom a)).eval b
      = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (a - k * b - j) := by
    intro a b
    rw [hF]
    simp [hg, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  sorry
EOF
